name: The DGTL Residency — services-for-accommodation exchange for Toronto rental operators
notes: Composed via dgtl-pitch-composer; BLOCK PLAN saved alongside. Multi-tier ask (3-month Sprint vs 6-month Residency) traded for one vacant unit, $0 invoiced. Market stats sourced: CMHC Dec 2025 (3.0% vacancy), Rentals.ca Jul 2026 ($2,577 avg rent), Urbanation 2025 (65% incentives / 2 months free). Six Senses Ibiza is the trade-out precedent — no numeric metrics exist for that case, none used. Prospect dossier in prospects.md.
